name: EPIC 211687296

text.card: A red giant 4,204 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,660 K at its surface.
